title: Fortress

widgets.text: A Tetris-style castle builder: falling wall pieces build your fortress, which then grows cannons and towers that fire at the rival fortress.
Closed rings of wall turn into buildings: bigger rings make stronger buildings. Protect your keep; repair holes before adding new rings.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Four kingdoms (Viking, Ogre, Wizard, Elf style) with several battles each.

rows: Your king: losing it loses the battle

widgets.text: New pieces and building types unlock as you move through the campaign.
Win every battle in a kingdom to move to the next.
